Subject: Redwood SOC 2 / Audit logs, DPA & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to meet the Acme security and platform team. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and soojin and I know where to focus for the follow-ups.

Pain points / goals you called out:
- You need an external SOC 2 Type II report for Q1 procurement sign-off.
- Detailed audit logs (who, what, when) retained for at least 7 years for regulatory reasons.
- Ability to demonstrate DPA controls and encryption-at-rest/key management with customer-controlled KMS.
- Pen test evidence and remediation history is required by your InfoSec review.
- Data residency question: primary workloads must remain in us-west region.

What I heard as success criteria:
1) Final DPA + supporting artifacts delivered to your legal/security team by Nov 5.
2) Technical deep-dive session to validate audit logging, retention, and KMS integration before Nov 12.
3) Procurement approval and PO by end of November (target).

Next steps (proposed):
- I will send: SOC 2 bridge letter, redacted pen-test summary, and a SOC2 Q&A spreadsheet with mapping to controls (attached).
- Schedule 60-min technical deep-dive with our security engineer (Vivek) and solutions engineer (Soojin) — please share 2x 60-min windows next week when your team is available.
- We will provide a DPA draft for legal to review (attached).

Attachments: SOC2-answers-summary.xlsx, redwood-dpa-draft.pdf

If I missed anything important, call it out and I will update. Looking forward to the technical session.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifications / asks from our side:  

1) Retention: 7 years is ideal but we may be able to accept 5 years if retention proof (exportable audit logs) is trivial. Can you include export formats and retention policy enforcement in the deep-dive?
2) KMS: we use AWS KMS with a BYOK flow. Can Redwood support customer-managed keys / HSM integration?
3) Pen test: we need a 3rd-party pen-test report (redacted is fine) and a list of any critical/high findings plus remediation timelines. Is the pen-test-summary.pdf sufficient?
4) DPA: we'll send our standard security questionnaire (attached). Legal will want to redline the DPA draft as usual.

Our availability for the technical session: Oct 26 between 10-12 PT or Oct 27 after 1pm PT. Please let us know which works.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Sr. Security Engineer | Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

- Retention/export: Our audit log exports support JSON and CSV, include actor, operation, resource, timestamp, request/response ids, and can be exported via API or SFTP. We can demonstrate export and retention enforcement in the technical session.
- KMS/BYOK: Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS with a BYOK workflow and can integrate with customer-hosted HSMs where required. I'll have Vivek validate the HSM integration patterns in the session.
- Pen test: The attached pen-test-summary.pdf is a redacted 3rd-party assessment and includes a findings summary. I have attached the high-level remediation tracker as well. If you need the full report we can arrange an NDA and provide it.
- DPA: Understood — we'll expect legal redlines. We've attached our standard DPA draft to speed the process.

Proposed time: Oct 26, 10:30-11:30 PT — does that work for your team? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite with a technical agenda (audit logs demo, KMS/BYOK walkthrough, pen-test Q&A, compliance artifacts).

Attachments: pen-test-summary.pdf

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Send calendar invite for Oct 26, 10:30-11:30 PT (tentative).
2) Vivek to lead HSM/KMS validation and answer any cryptography questions.
3) Soojin to prepare a short demo of audit log export + retention enforcement.
4) Marissa to iterate on DPA as needed after legal redlines.

Looping in Vivek and Soojin for visibility.

Thanks for the summary and Alice for the availability. Oct 26, 10:30-11:30 PT works for me. Quick technical notes to set expectations:  

- Audit logs: we'll demo the export API and an S3-based retention bucket with lifecycle policies. Exports are signed URLs or SFTP transfer; retention enforcement is policy-driven inside the bucket and audit trail is cryptographically signed.
- BYOK: We'll walk through AWS KMS customer master key creation, key policy examples, and the BYOK rotation process. For HSMs, we'll outline the connector patterns and required network controls (VPC peering / private endpoint).
- Pen test: we will bring a redacted findings list and remediation history. If Acme needs the full report, we'll coordinate NDA and a secure share.

I'll prepare a short slide deck + demo script. Soojin, can you prepare the audit log export demo and a short walkthrough of the console retention settings?

See you on Oct 26.
